anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.liebe.0: So you call me up from the pit. How brave. How foolish.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.liebe.1: Magic is a lie that men tell themselves. I am what is left when the lie is cut away.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.liebe.2: Stand in the circle. If you flinch, I take the body.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.liebe.3: I offer you a cut through every spell. Sign, and we are one blade.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.lucifero: Who dares to pull a king up by the neck?
Weight is all there is. Kings, stars and men: everything falls toward me.
Do not bow. A bowed back is only easier to crush.
A throne of gravity for the one who can stand under it. Sign, or be pressed flat.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.beelzebu: Distance is a habit. I broke it long ago.
I stood at your door and behind you before you drew breath.
Every place is one place. Choose where you wish to be.
Take my hands and the world folds for you. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.astaroth: Hm. Another one who thinks the hour is theirs.
I watched you be born, and I have watched you end. Neither took long.
Wait. The clock is mine, and it will wait for you as well.
A little of my time for a little of yours. Sign, and the hour bends.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.megicula: A curse is only a wish with a debt on it. Let me see yours.
I stitch what is broken and I break what is stitched. Hold still.
You carry someone else's hatred. I can hear it hum.
My wards for your pain. Sign, and no curse will find your skin.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.lucifugu: Say it again. A name, once spoken, cannot be unspoken.
Words are older than flesh. I am only the one who remembers them.
Choose your next word with care: I will make it true.
Lend me your voice and I will lend it weight. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.fox_devi: ...Are you the one who called? You smell of meat.
Say it once more. Say it, and I will have a mouthful.
I will bite for you, and you will feed me a little. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.curse_de: A name, a face, a day. I need nothing else.
Everyone who has hated you leaves a stain. I only collect them.
Years are such small coins to someone who is dying anyway.
Pay me in years, and whoever you name will not see morning. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.future_d: Ah. You came. I knew you would.
I can see the end of this very hour. You say yes on the third breath.
Do not look away. I will sit in your eye and look for you.
Give me a window to look through, and nothing will ever surprise you again. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.ghost_de: Hands. So many hands. Let them have you, only for a moment.
I was only ever the thing you were afraid to meet in the dark.
Lend me one eye. I will lend you a thousand arms. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.sebastia: Good evening. You called, and so I came.
I am only a butler, but I do not fail at the little tasks.
Tell me what you want. And what you would pay for it.
A contract: your wish for your soul. A simple bargain. Sign it, my lord.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.kin_of_i: Warm. The circle is warm. I like that.
I burn the way the old ones burned: slowly, then all at once.
Do not fear the flame. Fear the cold that comes after it.
Fire in your hands, if you can bear to hold it. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.kin_of_e: The tide came up through the floor. Did you feel it?
Water takes the shape of whatever holds it. What holds you?
Be patient. Even a stone wears down.
Let the sea move you. Sign, and the deep will answer.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.kin_of_a: Stone. Soil. Bones of the world. I answer.
I was here before the roads and I will be here after the cities.
Stand firm. I do not like those who sway.
Take the weight of the ground in your arms. Sign.
Mm... something is spoiling in here. Is it you?
Everything ripens. Everything softens. Everything comes to me.
Do not hold your breath. It only delays the sweetness.
Let me in, and whatever touches you will wither. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.kin_of_l: Be still. The light has come, and it is not kind.
I am the first morning and the last. Your shadow is the only thing that argues.
Look at me. Not many can.
Take my radiance. Carry it, and burn what hides. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.daemon_n: A name was spoken. A black one. Mine.
I was old when the sky was young. I remember the first fall of night.
Give me a shape to walk in. I shall make it worthy.
Name me, and I will wear you like a cloak of dusk. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.daemon_b: Pale light, thin as a breath. Did you call?
I am the white that is left when everything else is burnt away.
Be quiet. Listen. Even the silence has a shape.
Let me be your mercy, and your edge. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.daemon_j: Hah! A fresh body and a bright mind. Lovely.
Amusing, isn't it? You are the one who is afraid, and I the one who comes laughing.
Enough waiting. Make up your mind; I am bored.
Give me the thrill of your life, and I will give you the sun. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.daemon_v: Oh, sweet. Something delicious was left in the circle.
Everything decays into something richer. I only hurry it along.
Do not struggle. It all feels better when it stops.
Be my vessel, and what you touch will turn to loam. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.daemon_r: Red, red, red. The air tastes of blood and promise.
I keep the souls I have borrowed. They are very quiet. You will be quiet too.
A soul is only a coin that has not found its pocket.
Hand me your soul to hold. I will give it back, mostly. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.daemon_v: Green. Slow. Rooted. I came as soon as I could.
Nothing grows faster than a forest after a fire. I know.
Do not hurry me. A mountain does not.
Let your roots go deep. Sign, and I will hold you up.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.daemon_b: Cold and deep and quiet. You woke me.
I have been under the waves so long I forgot what the sun looks like.
Tell me of the surface. Is it still loud?
Let me rise in you like a tide. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.hall_dem: Welcome to the hall. The statues have been waiting.
Prosperity is a heavy thing. It must be carried by someone's body.
Look around you: every face you see was once a buyer.
Your eye, a piece of your flesh, and the world is yours. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.god_hand: The sun is black, and you are the only one left standing in it.
We are four. We have always been four. You are the fifth.
Sacrifice is the only coin we accept.
Give us what you hold dearest, and we will give you a higher place. Sign.
anime_multiverse.devil.npc.line.etheriou: A book opens and a demon wakes. Hello, master.
Zeref wrote me in ink, and I have been waiting in the margins.
Ether, ether. Give me ether and I will give you the whole page.
Read me aloud, and I will answer. Sign my name.
